mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_record (user_number, type, subject_number, title, description, file_url, grade, semester) VALUES (#{userNumber}, #{type}, #{subjectNumber}, #{title}, #{description}, #{fileUrl}, #{grade}, #{semester})

choose.when: SELECT user_number AS number, name AS label, login_id AS sub_label, 'name' AS search_type FROM tb_user WHERE name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(nick_name, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR login_id ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY name ASC, user_number ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT subject_number AS number, subject_name AS label, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS sub_label, 'subject' AS search_type FROM tb_subject WHERE subject_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY subject_name ASC, subject_number ASC LIMIT 20

mapper.select:
SELECT r.record_number, r.user_number, r.type, r.subject_number, r.title, r.description, r.file_url, r.grade, r.semester, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM tb_record r LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_number = r.user_number LEFT JOIN tb_subject s ON s.subject_number = r.subject_number
r.type = #{type}
AND r.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ( u.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(u.nick_name, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.login_id ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND s.subject_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT record_number, user_number, type, subject_number, title, description, file_url, grade, semester, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_record WHERE record_number = #{recordNumber}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_record SET type = #{type}, subject_number = #{subjectNumber}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, grade = #{grade}, semester = #{semester}, file_url = #{fileUrl} WHERE record_number = #{recordNumber}
